description: Luw.ai Fluw AI: generate a photorealistic image or illustration from a text prompt (optionally guided by an input image) — concept art, interiors, products, marketing visuals. Set format="svg" for a vector illustration (Fluw Vector AI). Costs 2 credits per image.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

format.description: Output format; svg switches to Fluw Vector AI.

image.description: Optional guide image (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

styles.description: Design style names, e.g. ["Scandinavian"]; for Japandi use ["Japanese Design", "Scandinavian"]. Case-sensitive; see luw_list_options.

variations.description: Number of alternative designs (1-4, default 1); each is billed as a generation.

name: luw_generate_image
title: Text to image (Fluw AI)
